name: Clinic or healthcare
description: Doctors, dental and eye clinics, physiotherapy, diagnostics and wellness centres. Patients are anxious and in a hurry: they need to know you treat their problem, trust the doctor and book in a minute.

goals.prompt: What should the website do for your practice? Name the one or two results that matter most.
goals.why: A clinic site is judged by appointments booked and calls answered, and by whether patients trust the doctor on sight.

recommendation.statement: Get patients to book an appointment online
Show the doctors' qualifications and patient trust before the first visit

goals.reason: The two things that bring a new patient through the door.

audience.prompt: Who are your patients, and what are they worried about when they search for you? One per line; add if known: wants: ... | proof: ... | action: ... | from: ... | mood: ...
audience.why: A parent booking for a child, an older adult and someone in pain look for different things.

recommendation.segment: Patients and families in the neighbourhood
recommendation.need: Know you treat their problem, trust the doctor and book a time

recommendation.segment: Patients looking for a second opinion
recommendation.need: See qualifications, experience and clear next steps

audience.reason: The two groups most clinics serve; research in P2 refines them.

heroMustHave: The main speciality and the area in the headline, so a patient knows at once that this is the right clinic
The lead doctor's name and qualification near the headline
Today's opening hours and the phone number, large enough to tap on a phone

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Show the speciality, the doctor and the area, build trust, and lead the patient to book

pages.title: Treatments
pages.purpose: Explain each treatment in plain words: who it is for, what happens and how long it takes

pages.title: Our Doctors
pages.purpose: Introduce each doctor with qualifications, registration and experience

pages.title: The Clinic
pages.purpose: Show the clinic, the equipment and the care that sets it apart, with real photographs

pages.title: Book and Contact
pages.purpose: Make booking easy, with the form, phone, address, hours and map

pages.title: Patient Stories
pages.purpose: Let patients describe their experience, with their consent

pages.title: Questions Patients Ask
pages.purpose: Answer cost, pain, recovery time, first-visit and insurance questions

pages.title: Your First Visit
pages.purpose: Remove fear by showing what to bring, what happens and how long it takes

pages.title: Insurance and Payments
pages.purpose: State what insurance, cashless and payment options are accepted

pages.title: Facilities and Technology
pages.purpose: Show the equipment and the hygiene standards patients cannot see from outside

pages.title: Health Guides
pages.purpose: Publish reviewed guidance on common conditions that brings patients before they are in pain

pages.title: Health Packages
pages.purpose: Offer check-up and treatment packages with clear contents and prices

pages.title: Video Consultation
pages.purpose: Explain how to consult the doctor online and what it costs

questions.prompt: List the specialities and treatments you offer, most requested first.
questions.why: The first one is the hero headline; each gets its own section or page.

questions.prompt: Who are the doctors, with qualifications, registration numbers and years of experience?
questions.why: Patients choose the doctor before the clinic; credentials must be exact.
questions.reason: Credentials must be exact and cannot be guessed.

questions.prompt: How should an appointment request reach you?
questions.why: This decides what the Book button does and who answers it.

options.label: A form that the front desk checks
An online booking tool we already use

questions.reason: The simplest option that needs no new tool.

questions.prompt: What are your clinic hours, and how do you handle emergencies?
questions.why: Hours and emergency guidance appear in the hero and the footer.

questions.prompt: Which insurance or cashless options do you accept?
questions.why: Cost is the most common reason a patient hesitates.

questions.prompt: Which languages do the doctors and staff speak?
questions.why: Patients trust a clinic that speaks their language.
questions.reason: A common pattern; replace with the real list.

questions.prompt: Do you offer video or phone consultations?
questions.why: If yes, a video-consultation page and button are added.

questions.prompt: Which of these do you already have?
questions.why: Real photographs of the doctors and the clinic build trust far more than stock images.

options.label: Photographs of the clinic and equipment

/: hero naming the speciality and the area, with the doctor, the hours and the primary action
the main treatments in plain words
how booking works in three steps
a closing booking call to action
/doctors: a profile per doctor with photograph, qualifications, registration and experience

contentNeeds: Doctors' photographs, qualifications and registration numbers
List of treatments with short descriptions
compliance: Never state or imply a cure, guaranteed result or success rate the client has not supplied with a source
Doctors' qualifications and registration numbers must be exactly as supplied
Patient testimonials and photographs need the patient's consent; never use stock photos as patients
Advice pages are general information and must say that they do not replace a consultation

extras.note: An online booking tool cuts missed calls and lifts appointments.
A map and directions answer where the clinic is and how to reach it.
Real clinic and equipment photographs reassure anxious patients.
A 3D anatomical model can illustrate a treatment, if a properly licensed one exists.
